$\phantom{=}\blueD{2.7\cdot10^4}-3.7\cdot10^3$

question.content:
The table shown below gives the approximate enrollment at the University of Michigan every fifty years.

**How many more students were enrolled at the University of Michigan in $1950$ than in $1900$?**  
*Express your answer in scientific notation.*




Year|Approximate enrollment at the University of Michigan
:-: | :-:  
$1850$ | $7.2 \cdot 10^1$ 
$1900$| $3.7 \cdot 10^3$ 
$1950$ | $2.7 \cdot 10^4$ 
$2000$ | $3.8 \cdot 10^4$ 



[[☃ expression 1]] students
